work.title: BYTE issue 1, September 1975
work.artist_unknown: Checked the cover, contents p.3, editorial pp.4-6, full staff masthead p.9 and searchable issue text. Masthead names Bill Heydolph for photography and four art-department staff, but does not assign the cover; no individual attribution made. Robert Tinney's own interview explicitly dates his first cover to December 1975.

captures.credit: Original publication; individual cover credit not established
captures.changes: Whole cover rendered directly from public issue PDF at a maximum dimension of 300 pixels; no cropping, retouching or reconstruction.
